newsitem.title: USA: Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst launches TV initiative.
newsitem.headline: Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst launches TV initiative.

text.p: Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc said Wednesday it will create a company that will own television station properties in mid-sized markets throughout the United States.

Hicks Muse said it has committed a minimum of $100 million from its newly formed equity fund for the initiative, through which it plans to build a company to own television properties valued at between $500 million and $1 billion.
Hicks Muse said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire four middle-market television stations in a $160 million transaction it expects to complete in the first quarter of 1997.
The stations are in Flint, Mich.; Rochester, N.Y.; Monterey, Calif.; and Steubenville, Ohio.
